title: Week 12 pre-registration: significance bound of the ML increment, and the positioning of implied volatility as an anchor
author: Zhucheng Tong
written_before_running: 2026-10-03 (UTC); SHA-256 of this file recorded in HANDOFF.md before src/analysis_w12.py was first run
mentor_request_2026_09_30: ML increment needs a statistical significance bound; clarify whether implied volatility is worth being a candidate anchor

common.panel: S&P 500 point-in-time panel of Week 10/11 (src.analysis_w10.build_panel), 2019-10-17..2024-12-31; label = forward 252-day realised vol; ruler = EWMA (Week 4)
common.loss: absolute dollar error of the ATM chooser price (T1=0.5, T2=1) against the oracle price, row level
common.statistic: Delta_MAE(A,B) = MAE(A) - MAE(B), pooled over rows; positive = B better. Composite differences are reported alongside but are NOT used for decisions (the composite is a ratio and is unstable in sub-periods, see W11 recheck)
common.interval: ticker-cluster bootstrap: resample tickers with replacement keeping all of their rows; B = 2000, seed 12; 95% percentile interval; two-sided p = 2*min(P*(Delta<=0), P*(Delta>=0)). Inference is CONDITIONAL on the realised time path (it answers: in this period, is the gain general across stocks)
common.size_check_before_use: simulate 300 null panels with the same tickers/dates: d_it = s_{sector(i),t} + u_it, sector-day factor and ticker AR(1) noise with persistence and variance shares estimated from the observed Delta series, population mean forced to 0; the procedure is accepted if the rejection rate at nominal 5% lies in [2.5%, 7.5%]
common.fallback_if_size_fails: sector-cluster bootstrap (resample sectors, then tickers within) with its own size check; if that also fails, no significance is claimed and only descriptive intervals are reported
common.time_dimension: calendar years 2022, 2023, 2024 reported separately (a year is used only if it has >= 120 out-of-sample dates); with 1-year labels there are at most 3 non-overlapping windows, so NO time-dimension p-value is claimed
common.family_and_multiplicity: Holm correction at 5% over the family {H1, H2, H3, H4}

hypotheses.H1_anchor_swap: Delta_MAE(EWMA, GARCH-1d) on the ML out-of-sample rows
hypotheses.H2_ml_increment_PRIMARY: Delta_MAE(GARCH-1d, GARCH-1d + cross-sectional GBDT WITHOUT sector dummies) on all walk-forward out-of-sample blocks from the first block whose purged training set has >= 252 dates, through 2024-12-31. Model, hyper-parameters, purge (252+1 dates) and quarterly refits exactly as Week 11.
hypotheses.H2b_secondary: the Week 11 reported model (with sector dummies) on the same rows: reported, not in the family, not used for decisions
hypotheses.H3_iv_vs_garch1d: Delta_MAE(GARCH-1d, IV-365d-50delta) on the panel rows where EWMA, GARCH-1d, GARCH-1y, 252d realised and IV are all available
hypotheses.H4_iv_vs_free_smooth: Delta_MAE(S, IV) on the same rows, where S is whichever of {252d realised vol, GARCH-1y} has the LOWER MAE on those rows (choosing the stronger free comparator after the fact makes the test harder for IV, i.e. conservative)

iv_data.source: OptionMetrics optionm.vsurfdYYYY, days = 365, delta = +50 and -50, sigma_iv = mean of call and put implied vol; LOCAL research use only under the WRDS licence (data/wrds_local, git-ignored, excluded from zip and image); figures show derived results only, never the IV series
iv_data.security_mapping: a ticker is matched to an OptionMetrics secid only if the daily returns of optionm.secprd and of our price table correlate >= 0.98 over >= 250 common days (ticker-only matching is unsafe: tickers are reused and renamed); unmatched tickers are dropped and counted

decision_rules.ml_increment: ESTABLISHED (conditional on the period) if H2 is significant after Holm with Delta_MAE > 0 AND Delta_MAE > 0 in at least 2 of the 3 years; otherwise NOT ESTABLISHED

iv_classes.deployment_candidate: H3 and H4 significant after Holm with Delta_MAE > 0 AND deployability verified
iv_classes.research_candidate: H3 and H4 significant after Holm with Delta_MAE > 0 but deployability not verified
iv_classes.research_benchmark: otherwise (in particular if H4 fails: the advantage is then explained by smoothness that a free anchor already provides)

decision_rules.deployability: requires a public live IV source AND a same-day level comparison with OptionMetrics. Declared in advance: OptionMetrics ends 2025-08-29 and Yahoo only provides today's chain, so a same-day comparison is NOT feasible -> deployability = NOT VERIFIED. Yahoo coverage of 300-450 day expiries is reported descriptively only.
decision_rules.engineering_consequences: ML_SCOPE is expanded beyond JPM only if the ML increment is ESTABLISHED; the primary-anchor swap to GARCH-1d goes ahead (W11 decision) and H1 gives its interval
